note: USACE Rathbun Lake campground on a point in three loops (A, B, F), open grassy areas dotted with trees. Open ~May 8-Sep 29. --Claude
summary: Fees 22 -> 25-28 (rec.gov 2026 and 2027); max_rig 128 -> 96; 100% reservable, 14 per loop, 2/3-night minimums added; 50 amp and facilities confirmed. Pin 1.8 km off. Waterfront lead UP: official site photos show the lake across open grass.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD UP (stored 'not waterfront' and the note's 'wooded buffer' are wrong for the outer sites; stored call was made at a pin 1.8 km from the campground). rec.gov's own site photos show open water across mown grass from A12, A13, B04, F05, F06, F07 (also a filtered view from A11). That is at least lakeview under the floor rule. Measured from per-site coordinates on imagery (taken with the lake well down, a wide sand margin exposed): B04 about 50 m to the waterline, mown grass then brush then sand, no road between; F07 about 45 m to the brush edge and 60 m to the water, grass, no road in the frame; A12/A13 about 75-90 m, grass and brush. F06's photo shows the loop road or a path across the apron. Rec.gov overview calls it a 'lakefront campground' (marketing, no weight). Minimum move: not waterfront -> lakeview; B04 and F07 are the only candidates for lakefront, on the ~50 m bound and the open-apron rule. Rest of the loops are in trees.

PIN WRONG: stored 40.86000,-92.87100 is in woods north of the J5T arm, about 1.8 km from the campground (rec.gov's own facility point, 40.86278,-92.86778, is wrong too). Centroid of the 42 per-site coordinates, which land on the visible pads: 40.8440,-92.8726. Re-fetch elevation.

PHONE: rec.gov: 'FOR CAMPGROUND INQUIRIES DURING MAY- SEPTEMBER PLEASE CALL 641-724-3206. DURING CLOSED SEASON OCTOBER -APRIL PLEASE CALL 641-647-2464'. Stored is the off-season office number; give both (apply.py doesn't write it).

WEBSITE: the stored second line is Rock Island District (mvr.usace.army.mil), but Rathbun is Kansas City District: rec.gov's notice links http://www.nwk.usace.army.mil/Locations/District-Lakes/Rathbun-Lake/. Both answer 403 to plain HTTP, so neither page was read; suggest replacing mvr with the nwk URL.

SEASON: May 8-Sep 29 in the note is only a rate-season date range on rec.gov (2026-05-08 to 2026-09-29), and the phone line says May-September staffed. Left unset in the field; USACE page unread (403). Kept in the note as it stood.
